---
title: "Sjónabók pattern gallery"
subtitle: "About 600 Icelandic embroidery patterns, digitised as 0/1 charts. Filter by type, symmetry and source, then open a pattern to inspect it cell by cell."
page-layout: full
toc: false
include-after-body:
  - text: <script src="js/gallery.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<div id="gallery" class="gallery">
<aside class="filters" aria-label="Filters">
<button id="toggle-filters" class="filter-toggle" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="filter-body">Filters <span id="active-n" class="active-n"></span></button>
<div id="filter-body" class="filter-body">
<div class="filter-head">
<input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Search by file name, e.g. 5898_246" aria-label="Search patterns">
<button id="reset" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary">Reset</button>
</div>
<details open><summary>Type</summary><div id="f-kind" class="chips"></div></details>
<details open><summary>Symmetry</summary><p class="hint">Mirror: two halves match. Turn: same when turned. Glide: flipped and shifted, like footprints. <a href="about.html#symmetry">More, with pictures</a></p><div id="f-sym" class="chips"></div></details>
<details><summary>Symmetry group</summary><p class="hint">One code for all of a pattern's symmetry: <b>p…</b> for bands, <b>C</b> (turns) or <b>D</b> (turns and mirrors) for motifs. Hover a code for its meaning, or <a href="about.html#symmetry">see the pictures</a>.</p><div id="f-group" class="chips"></div></details>
<details open><summary>Source</summary><div id="f-source" class="chips"></div></details>
<details open><summary>Size and density</summary><div id="f-range" class="ranges"></div></details>
<label class="sort">Sort by
<select id="sort">
<option value="name">Source and number</option>
<option value="cells">Size, large first</option>
<option value="cells-asc">Size, small first</option>
<option value="density">Density, dense first</option>
<option value="density-asc">Density, light first</option>
<option value="pieces">Pieces, most first</option>
<option value="float">Longest float, first</option>
</select>
</label>
</div>
</aside>
<section class="results">
<p id="count" class="count" aria-live="polite">Loading patterns…</p>
<div id="grid" class="tiles"></div>
</section>
</div>
<dialog id="detail" class="detail" aria-labelledby="d-title">
<form method="dialog" class="d-close"><button aria-label="Close">×</button></form>
<div class="d-body">
<div class="d-view">
<div class="d-tools">
<label>Zoom <input id="d-zoom" type="range" min="2" max="24" value="8"></label>
<label><input id="d-grid" type="checkbox" checked> Grid</label>
<span id="d-colours" class="swatches" aria-label="Colours"></span>
<label title="Show the pattern repeated, to judge how it tiles"><input id="d-tile" type="checkbox"> Repeat</label>
</div>
<div class="d-canvas"><canvas id="d-canvas"></canvas></div>
<p id="d-cell" class="d-cell">Tap or hover a cell to see its row and column.</p>
</div>
<div class="d-info">
<h2 id="d-title"></h2>
<dl id="d-facts" class="facts-list"></dl>
<p class="d-dl"><a id="d-txt" download>0/1 chart (.txt)</a> · <a id="d-png" download>Image (.png)</a> · <a id="d-link">Link to this pattern</a></p>
<h3>Similar patterns</h3>
<p class="hint">Similar in shape, wherever a band starts and however it is mirrored. <a href="about.html#similar">How they are chosen</a></p>
<div id="d-similar" class="similar"></div>
</div>
</div>
</dialog>
```
